chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Suleiman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding a free man who dies and has a slave mother: 'She should be bought from her son's wealth, then emancipated, then she inherits.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to a slave mother when her free son dies according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi details the specific legal procedure for manumitting a slave mother upon her free son's death, ensuring her freedom is secured from his estate before final distribution. This ruling highlights the Shia juristic emphasis on honoring the mother's status and securing her liberty as a priority claim against the deceased's assets, reflecting the broader ethical imperative of filial piety in inheritance law.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan altogether, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Suleyman Bin Khalid, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> was saying regarding the free man who died and for him what a mother who was a slave. He said: ‘She should be bought from the wealth of her son, then emancipated (liberated), then she would inherit it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’

Amir al-Mu’minin, about the case of a free man who dies leaving behind his mother who is owned by someone, has said that she is bought with money from the legacy of her son, then is set free and then she is made to inherit him.’”
